mapper.select: SELECT c.*, p.name AS parent_name, p.name_en AS parent_name_en, p.code AS parent_code FROM sound_category c LEFT JOIN sound_category p ON p.id = c.parent_id WHERE c.is_active = true ORDER BY COALESCE(p.sort_order, c.sort_order), c.parent_id NULLS FIRST, c.sort_order
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sound_category c LEFT JOIN sound_category p ON p.id = c.parent_id WHERE c.id = #{id} AND c.is_active = true AND (p.id IS NULL OR p.is_active = true))

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sound_category c LEFT JOIN sound_category p ON p.id = c.parent_id WHERE c.id = #{id} AND c.is_active = true AND (p.id IS NULL OR p.is_active = true) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sound_category ch WHERE ch.parent_id = c.id AND ch.is_active = true))

SELECT c.*, p.name AS parent_name, p.name_en AS parent_name_en, p.code AS parent_code, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM block b WHERE b.category_id = c.id AND b.is_active = true) AS block_count FROM sound_category c LEFT JOIN sound_category p ON p.id = c.parent_id WHERE c.code IS NOT NULL ORDER BY c.parent_id NULLS FIRST, c.sort_order, c.id
SELECT c.*, p.name AS parent_name, p.name_en AS parent_name_en, p.code AS parent_code FROM sound_category c LEFT JOIN sound_category p ON p.id = c.parent_id WHERE c.id = #{id}
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sound_category WHERE code = #{code})
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sort_order), 0) + 1 FROM sound_category WHERE parent_id IS NULLparent_id = #{parentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sound_category (code, name, name_en, color, icon, description, description_en, parent_id, sort_order, is_active) VALUES (#{code}, #{name}, #{nameEn}, #{color}, #{icon}, #{description}, #{descriptionEn}, #{parentId}, #{sortOrder}, true)
mapper.update: UPDATE sound_category SET code = #{code} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE sound_category SET color = #{color} WHERE parent_id = #{parentId}
UPDATE sound_category SET sort_order = #{sortOrder} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sound_tag WHERE is_active = true ORDER BY sort_order
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sound_tag WHERE is_active = true AND id IN #{id}
SELECT bt.block_id, t.id, t.name FROM block_tag bt JOIN sound_tag t ON t.id = bt.tag_id AND t.is_active = true WHERE bt.block_id IN #{id} ORDER BY bt.block_id, t.sort_order
